verdict.rationale: The core lancedb/lancedb repository is Apache-2.0 open source, its storage layer runs on local NVMe, EBS, EFS or any S3-compatible store, and a community user reports embedding LanceDB directly in their own Electron app, so the core product can be run on user infrastructure. missing for 10: an explicit first-party self-hosting/installation guide in the pack, clarity on which Enterprise (remote db://) features are excluded from the self-hosted core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: GitHub reports the lancedb/lancedb repo license as Apache-2.0 (SPDX Apache-2.0).
That design makes it flexible enough to run across local NVMe, EBS, EFS, and any object store that exposes an S3-compatible API.
LanceDB is one of the few options for embeddable vector databases, and I have used it in my Electron application.
